newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Dec manufacturing employment up 4.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Dec manufacturing employment up 4.8 pct.

text.p: Employment in Mexico's manufacturing sector rose 4.8 percent in December 1996 compared with the same month the previous year, the National Statistics Institute (INEGI) said in a statement on Tuesday.
Hours worked in the time period rose by an average 3.8 percent, INEGI said.

The jobs boost was one of the largest of 1996, the institute said, with the greatest increases registered in the metal, machinery and equipment and textiles divisions. The smallest gains were seen in food and tobacco products and printing and paper products.
In textiles, wood-working and basic metals, hours worked registered the greatest gains for the month. Hours worked declined in paper products and printing businesses, according to INEGI.
